Item: Written job description: duties, hours, pay rate, start date
Confirm pay is at least CA minimum wage $16.90/hr (2026) or higher local rate
Experience with children of these ages; ask for specific examples
CPR / pediatric first aid certification (ask to see card)
Discipline, screen time, feeding, nap and safety approach
Driving: license, insurance, car seats (if driving kids)
Availability, backup plan for sick days
Ask candidate to show TrustLine registration or apply (trustline.org; 1-800-822-8490)
Call at least 2 references from childcare jobs
Verify work eligibility: Form I-9 after hire (uscis.gov/i-9)
Pay rate, overtime rule (personal attendant: over 9 hrs/day or 45 hrs/week = 1.5x)
Paid sick leave per CA law; paid holidays/vacation (optional)
Trial period, notice, house rules, confidentiality, emergency contacts
Register with EDD (DE 1HW) within 15 days of paying $750+ cash wages in a quarter
Federal: Schedule H if $1,000+ cash wages in a quarter, or FICA threshold met (see IRS Pub 926)
Give Form W-2 by Jan 31; consider a household payroll service
